name: King City: Open World
summary: King City: Open World is an action-adventure driving simulator designed for mobile platforms. Set in an expansive urban environment inspired by Indian cities, the game offers players a sandbox experience with a wide variety of interactive elements. Players can drive and pilot over 50 different vehicles, including cars, motorcycles, auto-rickshaws, helicopters, and airplanes. The game features various role-playing mechanics such as taxi and bus driving jobs, a functional public transport system including metro and local trains, character customization, and a fully explorable open-world map with dynamic traffic and pedestrian systems.
